limitations: 1–120 flat parent-before-child nodes per apply, <=300KB JSON
Whole owned-build replacement, no granular patch/variables/styles/variants/library APIs
Static SVG vectors only, no raster generation or arbitrary JS
Read snapshots are bounded; not all properties or whole libraries
SVG/PNG export <=1MB; exports reviewed/downloaded in application
32 recent request records in memory; restart requires reconnect/read-before-retry
Staging protects normal API failures, not a database transaction across Figma crashes
Successful node creation is not proof of beautiful visual composition
deployment: Use existing GitHub Actions. Windows artifact now includes figma-plugin; application can also download exact embedded plugin ZIP. Import once in Figma Desktop and keep plugin open; manual Allow edits required.
user_data: No real Figma document or Roblox scene was modified. Tests use temporary local profiles; no account tokens or test notes in source archive.
